_doc: Unranked (DECISIONS D-014; research/round_flow.md §0–§8, §14): "an exact copy of Ranked" without the map ban [Y10S2]. 6 rounds, first to 4, the sides swap at round 4; at 3–3 up to 3 overtime rounds, first to 5, swapping every round; defenders vote for the site and attackers must find it; Pick & Ban with a 15 s vote (Fandom), capped at 1 ban per side per half for our six-operator roster (PLAN §6.2, D-119; the host may set 0–2); prep 45, action 180, plant 7, fuse 45, disable 7; a defender outside for 1 s is detected [Y5S4]. The operator-pick time is the research's best guess (30 s), the first overtime round's sides are unverified (D-121), and the round-end banner (6 s, no replay) is ours. Reinforcements: Siege's 10 scaled for small teams (D-015), the host may switch the scaling off.
